## Battery charging duration 10-80% (DC 150kW)

Charge your EX30 from 10 to 80 per cent from 26 minutes at DC fast charging stations.

**Charging reminder**

Get charging reminders when the battery drops to 20 per cent. The centre display shows nearby charging stations on Google Maps, along with navigation and estimated charge levels on arrival.

**Battery pre-conditioning**

Select a charging station as your destination, and the car can heat or cool the battery before you arrive. Pre-conditioning the battery can ensure it reaches the optimal temperature for charging, so you spend less time waiting at the station.

This figure is the typical time to charge from 10 to 80 per cent at a 175kW DC fast charging station. Figures are preliminary and derived from estimates and calculations performed for the Volvo EX30. These outcomes are not guaranteed. Charging times can vary and depend on factors such as outdoor temperature, battery temperature, charging equipment, battery condition and car condition. ### Scandinavian-inspired design

The EX30 exterior captures the essence of Scandinavian design with beautiful details that are also practical. From improving aerodynamics to housing vital sensors, every aspect of the exterior blends form and function. The result is an SUV that's distinctive – and distinctly electric.

![](https://www.volvocars.com/static/shared/icons/v5/plus-16.svg)

![Rear view of the fully electric Volvo EX30.](https://www.volvocars.com/images/cs/v3/assets/blt0feaa88e629251fc/blt405b9cae045066d1/694150b2c519a81924f45475/my27ex30-bento02-4-5.jpg?branch=prod_alias&quality=85&format=auto&iar=0&w=3840)

### Black roof and spoiler

A roof spoiler adds a sporty touch to the exterior and improves aerodynamic efficiency. It also cleverly hides a brake light and rear wiper washer nozzle. The optional black roof with colour-coordinated spoiler emphasises the car’s low centre of gravity, adding to its athletic stance on the road.

### Six wheel designs

Exclusive new wheels are designed to be light and aerodynamic for improved handling and energy efficiency. They’re available in 18-inch, 19-inch, 20-inch sizes, as well as the striking Black Edition 19" Glossy black wheel.

The diamond-cut designs use sharp angles and hidden bolts to create the illusion of larger wheels with extended spokes. And glossy black inserts contrast beautifully with the wheel’s aluminium surfaces.

Dynamic 5-seater

### Dynamic 5-seater

The EX30 delivers the utility SUV drivers love in a scaled-down package. It hits the right notes style-wise, too, with a high ground clearance, balanced proportions and confident stance. And despite its size, it's a comfortable 5-seater suited to an active lifestyle.

High-visibility LED lights

### High-visibility LED lights

Our signature Thor’s Hammer headlights have a wide, segmented design and adjustable height. The long LED light pattern provides excellent visibility, and you can automatically switch between low and full beams to avoid dazzling other drivers.

The C-shaped rear lights feature two sections that sit flush with the car body, adding to the SUV’s seamless appearance.

Look for the welcome or farewell light sequence as you approach or leave the car – a friendly twinkle to mark every trip.

Spacious boot

### Spacious boot

The boot of your EX30 can hold up to 400 litres. Fold down the rear seat backrests to bump that up to 1000 litres, including a 61-litre compartment under the boot floor.

The inner wheel arches are pushed out of the way to widen the boot and create a flat floor. Lower the boot floor to stow heavy or bulky items – it’s simple enough to do with one hand.

The power-operated tailgate opens with the touch of a button outside the car or on the centre display. At higher equipment levels, you can use your key fob or the Volvo Cars app.

Extra height improves ground clearance, so rough tracks and steep curbs are easier to handle. You also get a more commanding view behind the wheel.

![Close-up of the all-terrain wheels and front bumper on the EX30 Cross Country behind some grass.](https://www.volvocars.com/images/cs/v3/assets/blt0feaa88e629251fc/bltaf7bbe93168e6822/67c718ceab3eba862b276323/Overview-cross-country-carousel-2-4x3-cc.jpg?branch=prod_alias&quality=85&format=auto&iar=0&w=3840)

#### Versatile by nature

Expressive in the city and rugged outdoors. Matte black trim and 19-inch wheels give this SUV a bold, ready-for-anywhere look.

![Rear-angled close-up of the all-terrain wheels of the EX30 Cross Country.](https://www.volvocars.com/images/cs/v3/assets/blt0feaa88e629251fc/blt1c8dcbab7723c6ff/67c718ead53648404224f896/Overview-cross-country-carousel-3-4x3-cc.jpg?branch=prod_alias&quality=85&format=auto&iar=0&w=3840)

Opt for 18-inch wheels with all-terrain tyres for improved grip and comfort, adding a little extra assurance when you’re off the beaten path.

## Learn more about the Volvo EX30

Is the Volvo EX30 only available as a fully electric vehicle?

![](https://www.volvocars.com/static/shared/icons/v5/chevron-down-16.svg)

Yes. If you’re not ready to go fully electric, check out our range of [plug-in hybrid SUVs](https://www.volvocars.com/uk/cars/plug-in-hybrids/).

How long can I drive before I need to charge the battery on the fully electric Volvo EX30?

![](https://www.volvocars.com/static/shared/icons/v5/chevron-down-16.svg)

The Volvo EX30 has an estimated range of between 209.4 miles and 303.9 miles, depending on your chosen powertrain. To maximise your range and improve charging efficiency, pre-condition the battery before you set off and on your way to charging stations.

Range figures are preliminary and based on WLTP testing standards obtained under specific testing conditions for the EX30. These outcomes are not guaranteed. Real-world range varies depending on driving behaviour and other external factors. Vehicle certification pending.

What’s the range of the Volvo EX30?

![](https://www.volvocars.com/static/shared/icons/v5/chevron-down-16.svg)

The P5 Electric has a range of up to 209.4 miles. The P5 Long Range Electric option has a range of 303.9 miles. The P8 AWD Electric powertrain has a range of 279.6 miles.

Range figures are preliminary and based on WLTP testing standards obtained under specific testing conditions for the EX30. These outcomes are not guaranteed. Real-world range varies depending on driving behaviour and other external factors. Vehicle certification pending.

How much does it cost to charge the battery of the Volvo EX30?

![](https://www.volvocars.com/static/shared/icons/v5/chevron-down-16.svg)

The cost of electricity varies, but the cost to charge an electric vehicle can be lower than the equivalent petrol or diesel car. Many people switch to electric vehicles for this lower running cost.

Where can I charge my Volvo EX30?

![](https://www.volvocars.com/static/shared/icons/v5/chevron-down-16.svg)

The quickest place to charge is at a DC fast charging station. You can find public charging locations using the Volvo Cars app or Google Maps in regions where charging stations are listed. A Volvo home wallbox lets you charge conveniently overnight. Read more about charging in the [electrification hub](https://www.volvocars.com/uk/cars/electrification/charging-your-volvo/).

How long does it take to charge my Volvo EX30?

![](https://www.volvocars.com/static/shared/icons/v5/chevron-down-16.svg)

Charging from 10 to 80 per cent takes about 26 minutes at DC fast-charging stations. Use the centre display controls to reach 100 per cent if you need a full charge to reach your destination or the next charging station.

This figure is the typical time to charge from 10 to 80 per cent at a 175kW DC fast charging station. Figures are preliminary and derived from estimates and calculations performed for the Volvo EX30. These outcomes are not guaranteed. Charging times can vary and depend on factors such as outdoor temperature, battery temperature, charging equipment, battery condition and car condition. Vehicle certification pending.

Is the Volvo EX30 a safe car?

![](https://www.volvocars.com/static/shared/icons/v5/chevron-down-16.svg)

The EX30 may be small, but it’s as safe as you’d expect from a Volvo SUV. We’ve applied our industry-leading standards of protective safety and added new features. Learn more about our [safety heritage](https://www.volvocars.com/uk/safety/heritage/).

Does the Volvo EX30 have Apple CarPlay?

![](https://www.volvocars.com/static/shared/icons/v5/chevron-down-16.svg)

Yes, wireless Apple CarPlay comes standard on the Volvo EX30. It’s easy to connect your iPhone and access your apps, music and navigation directly through the car’s infotainment system. Wireless Apple CarPlay is compatible with an iPhone 6 or newer models running iOS 14 or later. Update to the latest software to optimise your Apple CarPlay experience.

Does the Volvo EX30 have Google built-in?

![](https://www.volvocars.com/static/shared/icons/v5/chevron-down-16.svg)

Yes, the Volvo EX30 features Google built-in. Access Google Assistant, Google Maps and Google Play from the centre display. Google, Google Play and Google Maps are trademarks of Google LLC.
